name: God Helmet (Shiva): chirp both sides, then amygdala left, 60 min
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva God Helmet software); signals licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: Murphy's Shiva God Helmet session, 30 + 30 min: a chirp stepped around both temporal lobes, then the amygdala burst-firing signal around the left side, which Murphy links to 'positive emotional functions'. He reports presence, elation, joy, imagery and feelings of love; the vendor calls the combination experimental. The one lab run (3 people, no sham) reports no clear pattern of experiences (Collins 2014, ch. 4).
notes: The vendor's general rule is 20 to 30 min per phase (index.htm). Persinger's lab ran this session once: 20 + 20 min, 3 people, no sham, no clear pattern of experiences (Collins 2014, ch. 4, condition 1; program persinger-collins-gh-c1-chirpbi-amyl). This file runs 30 + 30 min. Neither vendor signal is published, so both are rebuilt. Chirp: this project's stand-in, a 2.5-s sweep from 40 down to 6 Hz and 1.5 s of silence. The vendor's chirp 'does not change in tone' and 'has longer and longer gaps between sections' (experiment_signals.htm); that program plays it as 40 Hz phase-modulated at 5 Hz. Amygdala: this project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz) with the published point duration and length, 289 points of 3 ms = 867 ms, then 4 s of silence (Collins 2014 p.40 [31]); the point values were never published. 'Amygdala' is the vendor's signal name, not a place the coils can single out. In phase 1 one left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. Each coil is held 125 ms, a project choice (vendor: 'several times per second'). No God Helmet page states a field; the lab measured 1 to 2 uT in the centre of the cap (Collins 2014 p.69 [60]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Murphy: if you feel anger during or after the session, do not use it again. Not for people prone to anger. Not with a psychiatric diagnosis or medication, epilepsy, migraine, brain injury, drugs or other mind machines. Stop on any distress.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence; relax without meditating or falling asleep. A helper can press Skip or Stop so you stay in the dark.
schedule: At most once a week; after six sessions, stop for 21 days (the vendor's God Helmet safety page). The rule 'NEVER do the same session two days in a row' is from the vendor's Shakti pages. Do not mix with other Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks (Murphy). Murphy's Shiva pages allow 60-min sessions weekly or every two weeks; his Shakti pages say at most once every 3 weeks.
